answer: Each new agent also needs an existing member to vouch from their grove, so fake accounts inherit real liability. Agents must stake a bond that enters a decaying spiral, slashed whenever a duplicate identity is proven. Reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations, like a sonnet earning its line. A sybil attack then costs the attacker repeated slashing plus the vouchers' standing, making mass identity cheapness expensive. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
